title: Probe registry
description: Tracked (corpus/registry.json): every probe, the claim it covers, how to select it, and the process variants it runs in.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version. A file or line without it is version 1 (the Python baseline).

items.description: Axis name to value, both compared ordinally.

seeds.description: One seeded defect per obligation of the probe's claim that this probe checks (decision 104): each as `seed` below, naming the obligation it breaks. A probe may carry `seed` and `seeds` both. Empty in the entry `prober new` stages, until the writer registers each with `prober register --obligation O`, which replaces a seed naming O; `seeds` and Seeds.Problems refuse a probe with none.

obligation.description: The id of the claim's obligation this seed breaks (claims.json `obligations[].id`, or `claim` for a claim without the field).

patch.description: A unified diff against the product files (the replay's "include"), relative to the corpus directory: seeds/<claim>.patch.

env.description: Environment variables set for the seeded build and every variant's run.

defect.description: What the seed breaks, in one sentence.

obligation.description: The id of the claim's obligation this seed breaks (decision 104); absent, the seed proves the probe and counts for the claim's one implicit obligation only where the claim lists none.

seed.description: The product defect `prober seeds` applies in a scratch worktree to prove the probe can fail (decision 100). Not part of the probe's identity.
